method.description: Actual source and all chronological contact sheets inspected using view_image. Evenly spaced frames include 0, 4 and last. CPU FFmpeg decoding, filtering and PNG encoding limited to two threads each; no GPU or generation submission.

observations: Source excavator, cone and leaves are recognizable, face-free objects with broad contrasting colours; no source visual failure was found.

The two-section arm lowers the orange bucket toward the leaves and cone, then raises it again. Joint connections remain coherent across the 32 chronological samples; temporary bucket occlusion behind foreground props reads as overlap rather than disappearance.
Cab, blue window, red engine block, grey track band and two purple wheels persist without sudden sampled losses or major deformation. Cone and both leaves remain present.
The entire machine and props remain comfortably within the image throughout sampled views. The background and stationary base do not accumulate drift; no faces appear on the objects.
limitations: Sampled still-frame inspection, not real-time playback or inspection of every frame. Motion observations describe progression across samples; frame-perfect smoothness, inter-sample artifacts and seamless looping are not guaranteed.
Contact sheets use reduced-size frames; full-resolution extracted samples are retained beside them.
scope: Exact-source and exact-video sampled visual reward-video review only. No painting processing, build, emulator, imports or integration performed or approved.
